dct_title_s: Indonesia Earthquake: Damage Proxy Maps and Interferograms, Nov 2022
dct_description_sm: # Indonesia Earthquake: Damage Proxy Maps and Interferograms, Nov 2022 The **Earth Observatory of Singapore – Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS)** produced these damage proxy maps and interferograms for Indonesia Earthquake (Nov 2022) from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite images. Each map is a separate ZIP below with its GeoTIFF, a KMZ for Google Earth, the PNG figures and a text file describing how it was made and how to read it. ## Maps in this dataset - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Indonesia, Earthquake, 23 Nov 2022, v0.9** - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Indonesia, Earthquake, 23 Nov 2022, v0.9** - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Indonesia, Earthquake, 21 Nov 2022, v0.6** - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Indonesia, Earthquake, 21 Nov 2022, v0.6** - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Indonesia, Earthquake, 21 Nov 2022, v0.5** (superseded) - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Indonesia, Earthquake, 21 Nov 2022, v0.5** (superseded) - **EOS-RS Interferogram (unwrapped): Indonesia Earthquake, 2022/11/07-2022/11/21, v0.1** - **EOS-RS Interferogram (wrapped): Indonesia Earthquake, 2022/11/07-2022/11/21, v0.1** **More map details and files:** **More map details and files:** **Credits:** Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS), Advanced Rapid Imaging and Analysis (ARIA), NASA-JPL/Caltech, Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2022)
